debug.label: Debug Mode
debug.hint: Leave this disabled unless specifically asked to enable it by Illandril (otherwise, it will slow things down).

setting.minimumRole.label: Minimum Role for Quick Actions
setting.minimumRole.hint: The Quick Actions menu will show when right-clicking on tokens owned by the user if they have the selected Role or greater. Note: GMs "own" every token.

showOnlyFavorites.label: Show Favorites Only
showOnlyFavorites.hint: If checked, for characters that have at least one 'Favorite', only actions for items in their favorites will be displayed.

showRequiredAmmo.label: Show Ammunition Counts
showRequiredAmmo.hint: If checked, for items that use ammunition, the current ammunition count will be shown next to the item name in the Quick Actions menu.

showItemsInContainers.label: Show Items in Containers
showItemsInContainers.hint: If checked, items that are inside containers will be shown in the Quick Actions menu.

setting.showUnpreparedNPCSpells.label: Show Unprepared NPC Spells
setting.showUnpreparedNPCSpells.hint: If checked, spells that have the "Prepared" Spell Preparation Mode that are not marked as "Prepared" will be shown in the Quick Actions menu for "Player Character" type actors without a player owner. (Note: these spells will appear in the Quck Actions menu for "Non-Player Character" type actors regardless of if they have a player owner or not and regardless of this setting.)
setting.showUnpreparedPCSpells.label: Show Unprepared PC Spells
setting.showUnpreparedPCSpells.hint: If checked, spells that have the "Prepared" Spell Preparation Mode that are not marked as "Prepared" will be shown in the Quick Actions menu for "Player Character" type actors with a player owner.
setting.showUnequippedNPCItems.label: Show Unequipped NPC Items
setting.showUnequippedNPCItems.hint: If checked, items that are not not marked as "Equipped" will be shown in the Quick Actions menu for "Player Character" type actors without a player owner. (Note: these items will appear in the Quck Actions menu for "Non-Player Character" type actors regardless of if they have a player owner or not and regardless of this setting.)
setting.showUnequippedPCItems.label: Show Unequipped PC Items
setting.showUnequippedPCItems.hint: If checked, items that are not not marked as "Equipped" will be shown in the Quick Actions menu for "Player Character" type actors with a player owner.
setting.showZeroUsesRemainActions.label: Show Actions with Zero Uses Left
setting.showZeroUsesRemainActions.hint: If checked, actions that have zero uses remaining will be shown in the Quick Actions menu.
setting.showForPCActors.label: Show for Player Character Actors
setting.showForPCActors.hint: If checked, the Quick Actions will show for Player Character actors. Note: This is based on the actor type, not based on if the actor has a player owner or not.
setting.showForNPCActors.label: Show for Non-Player Character Actors
setting.showForNPCActors.hint: If checked, the Quick Actions will show for Non-Player Character actors. Note: This is based on the actor type, not based on if the actor has a player owner or not.
setting.showForVehicleActors.label: Show for Vehicle Actors
setting.showForVehicleActors.hint: If checked, the Quick Actions will show for Vehicle actors.
